name: loyalty-card
summary: A points or stamp card on a shop photo that tilts and flips to a member code.
props: Shown on the back under the code.
Draws progress toward the next reward.
{ filled: number; total: number; reward?: string }
Card art — a photo of the shop, product or a texture.
Draw a real scannable code on the back.
Card colour when there is no image.
{ ready?, more?, reward?, points?, toNext?, back? }
Every built-in string, for translation ({n} and {reward} are filled in).
behavior: Tap the card to flip it to the member code for the till, and tap again to turn it back.
With tilt on (the default) the card leans toward your finger with a moving reflection, then turns over in 3D on a spring.
The card is a button labelled with the brand, member and their points or stamp count.
